purpose: Stop technically valid but confusing gameplay captures from reaching Kevin, the website, social channels or distribution partners.

moments.title: THE CREATURE HELPS
moments.nextCaptureMustShow: Move one real blocked route or danger into the foreground, make the creature's physical action large and unmistakable, show the route visibly change, and keep explanatory copy away from the action.

moments.title: A CHOICE CHANGES SOMETHING
moments.nextCaptureMustShow: After the short plain-language choice closes, transform a large part of the playable world—dead route to living route, still current to moving current, or another persistent change visible without reading the recap.

moments.title: A STRANGE DISCOVERY
moments.nextCaptureMustShow: Build one impossible physical event into the playable world—liquid memory climbing upward, folded light opening a route, migrating geometry, or living gravity—with both actors visibly reacting to it.

moments.title: MOVEMENT FEELS ALIVE
moments.nextCaptureMustShow: Record six to ten uninterrupted seconds through a complete richly layered section, including a jump or obstacle, moving environmental life, readable platforms and the creature continuously moving beside the astronaut.

realmRecapture.meaning: A replacement realm capture should not hide a performance problem. The gameplay scene needs another iteration before it can become launch proof.

nextGate.request: Treat marketing capture as a gameplay presentation feature: stage one foreground action, one dramatic world transformation, one impossible alien phenomenon and one rich traversal route. The current effects prove state changes but still do not tell those stories visually.
